description: This file defines classes and functions for parsing command-line arguments related to AAudio stream configuration, including applying parameters to stream builders, and comparing stream parameters with requested values. It includes dynamic loading of external AAudio functions and manages various stream settings such as buffer size, format, usage, and privacy options.

classes.name: AAudioParameters
classes.description: Class encapsulating AAudio stream parameters with methods to set, get, and apply configuration to stream builders.

classes.name: AAudioArgsParser
classes.description: Subclass of AAudioParameters that adds command-line argument parsing, stream parameter comparison, and usage display functionalities.

methods.name: loadFutureFunctions
methods.description: Dynamically loads external AAudio functions from libaaudio.so.

methods.name: applyParameters
methods.description: Applies stored parameters to an AAudioStreamBuilder instance.

methods.name: parseArg
methods.description: Parses a single command-line argument to set parameters.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for command-line arguments.

methods.name: parseAllowedCapturePolicy
methods.description: Parses a character to determine allowed capture policy.

methods.name: parsePerformanceMode
methods.description: Parses a character to determine performance mode.

methods.name: compareWithStream
methods.description: Prints comparison of current parameters with actual stream parameters.
